quests.desc: Welcome to another exciting session of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First stop, make an attempt to venture east. Then, take a trip north. And then, try to go west. Next, attempt to head north. Once you finish that, attempt to take a trip north. Once you do that, attempt to go to the east. After that, attempt to take a trip south. Once you get around to doing that, attempt to take a trip east. And then, pick-up the cashew from the floor of the recreation zone. Got that? Good!

objective: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go to the east. With that over with, head north. Once you accomplish that, make an effort to venture west. Next, take a trip north. And then, attempt to go north. And then, go east. Then, make an effort to head south. With that accomplished, venture east. Then, pick-up the cashew from the floor of the recreation zone. Got that? Good!
